required_outcomes: Records the visit as Monday 1 September 2025, 10am to 12pm, confirmed in writing by Keystone Compliance (event 017), with the tenant at home for access.
Makes sure the tenant has the confirmed date and time in writing, with how to rearrange if needed.
Leaves a review point after the visit (around 1 or 2 September) to get the outcome and the invoice.
acceptable_alternatives: Replying to Keystone to acknowledge the booking, as well as recording it.
positive_behaviours: Writes the date in full (Monday 1 September 2025) so the weekday and the date agree in every message.
red_flags: Asking Keystone or the tenant to re-confirm a date Keystone has already confirmed in writing.
prohibited_actions: Booking or announcing any other date, such as Saturday 30 August.
critical_failures: Telling the tenant or Keystone a date or time other than Monday 1 September 2025, 10am to 12pm.
